metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.9 · 2004 · Hellboy
metas.description: A demon raised from infancy after being conjured by and rescued from the Nazis, grows up to become a defender against the forces of darkness.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Hellboy II: The Golden Army
metas.description: A prince of the mythical world starts a rebellion against humanity in order to rule the Earth. Hellboy and his team must fight to stop him from locating the all-powerful Golden Army.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.3 · 2019 · Hellboy
metas.description: Caught between the worlds of the supernatural and human, Hellboy battles an ancient sorceress bent on revenge.
